project.title: InternScrap: IBM Db2-Powered Internship Aggregator & Lifecycle Tracker
project.short_description: An automated tech internship aggregator and application pipeline tracker demonstrating enterprise relational modeling, performance indexing, and analytical views on IBM Db2.

ibm_db2.edition: IBM Db2 Community Edition (Docker) / Db2 on Cloud
features_used: Relational Schema & Foreign Key Constraints (COMPANIES, INTERNSHIPS, SKILLS, APPLICATIONS)
Advanced Db2 Views (V_ACTIVE_INTERNSHIPS, V_TOP_IN_DEMAND_SKILLS, V_APPLICATION_FUNNEL, V_UPCOMING_DEADLINES)
Db2 Developer Extension Workflows (DDL, Views, Sample Data & Query Plans)
